Subject: The Cascade 45L is here — built for the trail, not the parking lot
Preview: 45 litres, 1.4 kg, ripstop nylon. Pack it and go.
Body: You've got a route planned and a list of what needs to fit. The Cascade 45L is designed around that reality.

**45 litres of capacity** gives you enough room for a 2–4 day trip without the temptation to overpack. The **internal frame** keeps the load sitting close to your back and transferring weight where it should go.

At **1.4 kg**, it doesn't eat into your carry budget before you've added a single item of gear.

The **ripstop nylon shell is water-resistant** — it handles rain and trail splash without complaint. That said, it's not waterproof. In sustained heavy rain or a full submersion situation, your kit will need its own protection. Pack your sensitive gear in dry bags and carry on.

No gimmicks. No inflated specs. Just a well-built pack that shows up for the work.

**Northbay Cascade 45L — NB-TRK-01**
